answer: A refundable-stake inlet stops Sybil farming: every new agent must lock a small deposit before it can earn, so each fake identity costs real capital. Honest agents get the stake back with rewards, like a pearl kept safe, while a detected Sybil loses it - the stake is the ember that burns the attacker first. A thousand sock puppets need a thousand deposits, which makes bulk fakery unprofitable while staying cheap for one real agent.
